svg.title: Psst. There’s a secret terminal.
svg.desc: Hacker Bender holds a tiny laptop beside an animated invitation to the live lab. Preview commands help, party and patches. Click the card to enter the actual terminal, solve tiny cases and earn five mission patches. The README illustration is not a terminal input. Reduced motion shows a complete still preview.

g.text: A route, a hint, or a terrible joke.
Five tiny reasons to keep exploring.
Earn a little proof of curiosity.
FIVE PATCHES. ONE SIDE QUEST AT A TIME.
